claims: Scottie Scheffler was born in Ridgewood, New Jersey, on June 21, 1996.
Scottie Scheffler spent his early childhood in Montvale, New Jersey.
Scottie Scheffler moved with his family to Dallas, Texas, at age six.
Scottie Scheffler moved to Texas in the wake of the September 11 attacks.
Scottie Scheffler was raised in Dallas, Texas.
Scottie Scheffler developed his golf game in Dallas, Texas.
Scottie Scheffler currently resides in Dallas, Texas.
Scottie Scheffler's college is University of Texas at Austin.
Scottie Scheffler has acknowledged his New Jersey roots.
